KB국민은행은 현재 예산 재편성 작업 중이며 내년 정보보호 예산을 1000억 원 이상 규모로 배정하겠다고 밝혔다. 하나은행은 1001억 원, 우리은행은 763억 원을 편성했다. 예산을 늘리는 것뿐만 아니라 실제 집행률을 높이는 것도 과제로 꼽힌다. KB국민은행은…
regions.en: 4th Daegu Bank (KB Kukmin·New·We·One) expanded and stood out the financial budget for the next year. According to the data submitted by the Bank of Korea, the President of the National Assembly of the 9th National Assembly of the Republic of Korea, Shinhan Bank has organized the financial budget for the next year. This year, a scale of 2.8 times in KRW 406 billion. KB Kookmin Bank announced that it is currently reorganizing budget and will be distributed to more than 1000 million KRW of information protection budget. Hana Bank has won KRW 100 billion, and our bank has won 763 billion. In addition to increasing budgets, it is also a challenge to increase real enforcement. KB Bank
